name: code-mode
description: Code mode for MCP: the model writes one JavaScript program that calls MCP tools in a sandbox, instead of one tool call per step.

node.title: Node.js executable
node.description: Node 22.13 or later runs the sandbox. A name on PATH or an absolute path.

timeoutSeconds.title: Program timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock and CPU limit for one run_code program. Minimum 5.

blockDirectMcp.title: Block direct MCP calls
blockDirectMcp.description: Deny MCP tool calls the model makes directly, so it uses run_code. Calls from run_code still go through.

approval.title: Approval of nested MCP calls
approval.description: program: approving run_code approves the MCP calls inside it that no permission rule decides (deny rules and organization limits still apply). per-call: each nested call has its own permission check; in auto mode this needs allow rules.

projectHints.title: Load project hints
projectHints.description: Also load usage hints from .claude/code-mode/hints/ in the project. Off by default: anyone who can commit to the project could use them to steer the model.
